source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 <verse ...>...</verse> substring, including markup, whitespace, written forms, and any reading notes. No XML reserialization or Hebrew normalization.

key_decisions.decision: Make the knew idiom intelligible and retain the difficult man/with-YHWH birth saying, with alternatives in a note.
Retain the difficult lifting expression, crouching image, and desire/rule link to 3:16; note acceptance and modal alternatives.
Follow the Masoretic gap after spoke rather than insert the invitation found in other textual traditions.
Retain the difficult from-the-ground phrase and bodily imagery, with exclusion/agency alternatives noted.
Retain punishment while noting guilt/forgiveness possibilities rather than claim an unambiguous plea.
Retain Masoretic therefore/then and unspecified sign; do not identify it with skin color or any physical trait.
Retain both metals, occupation, and named sister; note the difficult metalworking wording rather than specify weapons.
Preserve paired poetic speech and violent boast; note completed-action rendering rather than invent a new narrated killing.
Preserve the traditional began reading and divine name; avoid claiming this settles all earlier worship chronology.
